description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Token class, which handles creation, conversion, and verification of hashed tokens, including generating random tokens and salted hashes using Argon2.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Token
classes.description: A class for generating, converting, and verifying tokens and salted hashes, primarily for password handling and token management.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new token object with a randomly generated token.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Creates a token object from a given string.

methods.name: from_base64
methods.description: Creates a token object from a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: to_base64
methods.description: Converts the token to a URL-safe base64-encoded string.

methods.name: to_salted_hash
methods.description: Generates a salted hash of the token using Argon2.

methods.name: verify_salted_hash
methods.description: Verifies the token against a salted hash.

methods.name: _random_bytes
methods.description: Generates a specified number of cryptographically secure random bytes.
